senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; טָרַף)an animal torn by a beast of prey.
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00862"><he>טֶרֶף</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (ritual law) an animal afflicted with a (fatal) organic disease, the discovery of which, after slaughtering, makes it forbidden, t’refah, (of persons, m.) one having a fatal organic disease (the killing of whom would not be considered murder before the law).
units: Ḥull. 42ᵃ ט׳ אינה חיה a t’refa animal cannot survive (a year); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78a:9">Snh. 78ᵃ</cite> <he>ההורג את הט׳</he> if one kills a person afflicted with a fatal organic disease; <he>וט׳ שהרג</he> and if such a person committed a murder.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 78a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>עידי ט׳</he> witnesses afflicted &c.; a. fr.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:3">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="H00716"><he>החיה</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 11:2">Lev. XI, 2</cite>) <he>החיה מטְרֵיפָתָהּ וכ׳</he> that which can recover from its disease, you may eat.—Pl. <he>טְרֵיפוֹת</he>, <he>טְרֵפוֹת</he>.
Ḥull. III, 1; a. fr.—Esp. cases of t’refah, ritual law concerning t’refah.
